en:
Oh, yeah. You don't know much about
music, do you, Shuichi?

I kind of follow the trends?
I don't know anything about classical.

I guess that's true. Normal high school
boys don't listen to classical music...

But you've definitely heard of Chopin,
right?

Yeah. He's pretty famous, so 
I've definitely heard of him.

Chopin composed many solos, and was even
referred to as The Poet of the Piano.

That title might mean nothing to you at first,
but you'll get it once you listen to his works.
He always performed at concerts.
You perform too, right Kaede?

Of course! I personally enjoy Prelude, Op. 28,
No. 15, or also known as the Raindrop prelude.
Oh, yeah. Speaking of Chopin...

I played the three Waltzes, Op. 34 in front
of a king before.
A king?

Yeah, some European king.
He had to keep his identity a secret.

What!?
Why did he have to do that!?

He saw my performance at an international
competition on the news, so he came to Japan.
Wow...

But he looked like your average Joe.
Nothing like a king out of a fairytale.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't think a king would like to
be called an "average Joe."

But he talked like a king! His speech and
mannerisms were totally not this era!
"It is as if a god dwells within your fingers!"

He knelt down when he said that!
I was speechless!

<CLT=cltMIND>I...don't know how
to respond to that.
Did any other famous people come?

Yeah, sorta. A representative of Juilliard,
famous pianists...

I was really nervous back then.
Like, what were they gonna tell me after?

But in the end, I performed my usual way
and hoped they enjoyed it.

That's incredible... You must be really
amazing if you have fans like that...

Hahahaha!
No way, Shuichi!

I'm an ordinary high school girl who just
happens to be a Piano Freak.

I don't think such important people
would come to see an ordinary pianist.
Well, you're the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>, Shuichi.

One day, you're gonna get famous people
requesting you to solve their cases.
<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, no, probably not...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kaede's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaede and I parted ways,
and I returned to my room.
